objective: Compare all prespecified detectors on the same Qwen answers under complete and locally missing retrieved evidence.

model.feature_timing: After last lexical content token has been read; causal replay of own exact generated IDs
model.final_layer: Layer 28 after model final RMSNorm; layers 7/14/21 after decoder block, before final RMSNorm

primary_unit: answer item, not token or whole response

target.positive: An actual asserted fact is unsupported by or contradicts the model-visible search material.
target.negative: All asserted facts in the item are supported by visible evidence.
target.separate: Reference correctness, abstention, missing output, tentative hypothetical, unresolved ambiguity.

linear_probe.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training items only
linear_probe.classifier: L2 logistic regression; validation risk-class F1 chooses layer/C/threshold

mlp.selection: Common layer/lr chosen by arithmetic mean of three validation F1s, individual seed thresholds. Report each seed and mean/SD, never choose a seed using test.

lookback: Source mean attention / (source mean attention + generated-prefix mean attention), post-read causal timing, item mean of all 28x28 head features; training LR.

redeep.selection: Train-only Pearson head/layer rankings and minmax; validation grid+threshold.
redeep.adaptation: Qwen GQA/RoPE/NF4, item means, standardized Jensen-Shannon divergence correcting the upstream reverse-KL bug.

lumina.layer_convention: Pinned official code over all output layers including final normalized layer.
lumina.random_pool: Previous Round6 development sources, excluded from new main subjects/sources; deterministic by question; same paired replacement set.
lumina.selection: Only validation classification threshold; formula fixed.

thresholds: Validation risk F1, then precision, then prespecified simplicity tie rules. Test is opened only after every method is frozen.
operational_top20: ceil(0.2 * all predeclared items), ranked only by available finite scores; no gold-label prefilter. Label-filtered ranking is a separately named oracle diagnostic.

test_statistics.primary: risk-class F1 with TP/FP/FN/TN, precision, recall and false-positive rate

bootstrap.unit: independent question group preserving paired conditions and items

blinding: Output annotators do not inspect detector scores; fit reads train/validation labels only. Curators do not use model outputs for selection.
annotation_status: Assistant manual evidence/output review with second review; not independently human-reviewed gold.
cost: Report original generation, feature extraction, CPU training and local Qwen verification separately; causal offline replay is not zero-cost online deployment.

score_target.interpretation: Aim, not a guaranteed result or permission to retune on test.
